# Bundled renderer

Direct STL export runs locally in a browser worker. No designs are sent to a rendering service.

Unmodified engine and loaders: @lofcz/openscad-wasm 0.0.2 from https://registry.npmjs.org/@lofcz/openscad-wasm/-/openscad-wasm-0.0.2.tgz . Package SHA-1: ad7e01a80cf3be428a2167fa3320fee4df438cd3.

Source and build instructions: https://github.com/lofcz/openscad-wasm (a fork of https://github.com/openscad/openscad-wasm). OpenSCAD source: https://github.com/openscad/openscad . See COPYING for GPL-2.0 license. This app selects the Manifold geometry backend.

LiberationSans-Bold.ttf and its accompanying license, authors and readme were extracted unchanged from openscad.fonts.js in the official OpenSCAD WASM release 2022.03.20. The same font bundle is included in the pinned package above. See FONT-LICENSE.txt, FONT-AUTHORS.txt and FONT-README.txt.
